name: Hell's Kitchen
desc:
THE DOORS TO HELL 2.0 ARE OPENING.

🔥Hell's Kitchen 2🔥

Welcome to Hell. Put on your apron and fight to win this season of Hell’s Kitchen. Burn dishes, battle raging fires, and adapt to chaotic wildcard rounds as you master hundreds of new recipes. All under the watchful eye of Gordon, where every mistake earns his wrath!

🧑‍🍳 Core Features:
- Fire Outbreaks
- Minigames
- 5 New Wildcard Rounds
- Chaos Reigns Supreme In The Kitchen
- Redesigned Hub, Kitchen And All New Environments
